OptiSoft (Account lead: Jordan Blake)
- Business context: Looking to standardize inference across 3 product lines; primary driver is reducing per-token costs while meeting regional latency targets for EU customers.
- Primary stakeholders: Claire Mendez (Platform), Sean Patel (Procurement)
